speaker: Patient

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Great Auricular Nerve Neuroma. The combination of "shooting" pain triggered by eating (jaw movement/compression) and specific tenderness when wearing earrings (direct pressure on the scar/tragus) following tympanoplasty is highly characteristic of a neuroma forming at the incision site of the great auricular nerve. The normal VEMP and audiogram results rule out inner ear pathology, confirming the issue is localized to the surgical scar and nerve.
